conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Hello, I want to know how to link my Aadhaar to my savings account. Nobody at the branch helped me!

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: I’m sorry for the inconvenience Sir. I can guide you through the process. Do you have your Aadhaar number handy?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Yes, it’s one two three four, five six seven eight, nine zero one two. But I don’t understand this online stuff.

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: No problem at all. You can visit the branch with your Aadhaar card, or I can send you a simple form to fill out and submit online. Which works better?

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: The form sounds good. Can you send it to my email?

conversation.speaker: RM
conversation.text: Absolutely. I’ve sent the form to your registered email. Please check and let me know if you need help filling it out.

conversation.speaker: Customer
conversation.text: Thank you so much, that’s really helpful.
